P.name: Happy Hour
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, after casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Gragas''' {{tip|heals}} himself for {{as|{{sti|health|{{fd|5.5}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}}}.

Q.name: Barrel Roll
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gragas''' rolls a cask to the target location, remaining there for 4 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area. Upon arrival, the cask starts to ferment over the first 2 seconds of its duration to increase its {{ccs|damage|magic}} and the effectiveness of its {{tip|slow}}, up to a maximum of 150% of their initial values. ''Barrel Roll'' can be recast at any time within its duration after the cask has fully travelled, and does so automatically after its duration ends.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Gragas''' detonates the cask, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, reduced by 30% against {{tip|minion|minions}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds.

W.name: Drunken Rage
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gragas''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, drinking out of his brew, and gains damage reduction for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
W.description2: Upon completing the channel, '''Gragas''' empowers his next [[basic attack]] within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to the target and nearby enemies, reduced to 50% against [[structures]]. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 140}} {{as|(+ 7% of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}

E.name: Body Slam
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gragas''' {{tip|dash|charges}} in the target direction and stops upon colliding with an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}}, though not through terrain, and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second.
E.description2: ''Body Slam's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 40% if '''Gragas''' hits an enemy.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Barrel Roll|Gragas}} and {{ai|Explosive Cask|Gragas}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Explosive Cask
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gragas''' hurls a cask that travels to the target location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, exploding on impact to deal {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within the area and {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} 900 units, though not through terrain, from the epicenter of the explosion, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second.
